title: Synthesis, characterization, and application of mixed-addenda silicon vanado tungstate polyoxometalate integrated into nanoporous MIL-101(Cr) for the quick removal of organic dyes from water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8918-8930
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00443H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hosna Malmir, Farrokhzad M. Zonoz, Mehdi Baghayeri, Reza Tayebee
In this work, a polyoxometalate, namely, [SiW9V3O40]−7, was successfully encapsulated into the pores of a MIL-101(Cr) metal organic framework (MOF) via a water-based, eco-friendly impregnation method.
